Juliet’s House Animal Rescue is a nonprofit, foster-based rescue in North Carolina dedicated to saving the most vulnerable animals — especially neonatal kittens, bottle baby kittens, orphaned puppies, and animals with complex medical needs. Many arrive weighing just a few ounces and require round-the-clock care to survive.

On this channel, you’ll see real rescue stories, neonatal care education, and the incredible transformations that happen when fragile animals receive the support they need. From bottle feeding and medical recovery to adoption day, we share the journey every step of the way.

Subscribe to follow these tiny fighters as they grow stronger each day — and see how compassion can change lives.

📍 Based in North Carolina
🐾 Foster-based rescue
💛 Saving the tiniest lives — one bottle baby at a time
